payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

node.question: Can the source mug be reliably matched to an edited object, and what visible continuity cues support that match?
node.criteria: Pass only if visible identity or continuity evidence reliably links the source mug to a specific edited object and permits its position to be judged. Fail only if clear evidence establishes that no matching source mug is present. Unknown if the blue blur, changed appearance, multiple mugs, or other ambiguity prevents a reliable match. Report the source mug's distinctive shape, handle, color, and scale against each plausible edited object; do not treat mere scene continuity or a plausible location as a match.
node.binding: Compare the source's large light-blue handled mug left of the headphones with the edited scene. Assess the blue blurred remnant and each pale mug separately, including the mug right of the headphones. State the specific matching cues and limitations; do not assume either pale mug is the source mug.
